breakthrough.name: THE OPPOSITE-SIGN AGING vs. DEMENTIA VECTOR (Why Healthy Aging Is NOT Mild Dementia!)
breakthrough.discovery: Colliding Lab #13 (N=99 healthy adults 18..82) with Lab #14 (N=88 clinical AD/FTD/CN) reveals a DOUBLE OPPOSITE-SIGN INVERSION on just 2 forehead electrodes: (1) Healthy Aging drives Δ_WK DOWN (r=-0.297 REM, r=-0.284 Wake) and median overnight Alpha UP (r=+0.371), whereas (2) Pathological Frontotemporal Dementia drives Δ_WK sharply UP (d=+0.753, p=0.0086) and Alpha sharply DOWN (d=-1.047, p=5.3e-5)! That proves pathological frontal neurodegeneration moves ANTI-PARALLEL (opposite direction!) to normal healthy brain aging.

rule2_6PaperCutUpCollisions.hypothesis: Shared Frontal E/I Disinhibition Signature Across FTD and PTSD: Both Frontotemporal Dementia (d=+0.753, p=0.0086) and PTSD/Threat Lock-In (+0.111 to +0.412) break frontal Δ_WK in the exact same POSITIVE direction, suggesting FTD behavioral disinhibition and PTSD hypervigilance share a common frontal 1/f-vs-DFA uncoupling axis — testable with a single 60-second forehead scan.

Orthogonal "Healthy Aging" vs. "Neurodegenerative Drift" 2D Screening Plane: Plotting (Δ_WK × AlphaFrac) separates Healthy Older Brains (Low Δ_WK, Preserved Alpha) from Early AD/FTD (High Δ_WK or Low Beta, Collapsed Alpha), solving the classic clinical confound where older healthy adults get false-positived as cognitively impaired.
